policy_text_full: Wyndham's Best Rate Guarantee matches a lower publicly available rate within 24 hours of booking. Wyndham Rewards membership is required, AND the claim must be filed at least 48 hours before check-in. Bonus: 25% off the lower rate.
policy_text_relevant_clause: Within 24 hours of booking AND at least 48 hours before check-in, Wyndham Rewards members can claim BRG for 25% off the lower rate.
